64-Year-Old Makes 9100% Gain, Pons Sparks Robinhood Launchpad War | HTX InsightsHomeCrypto News監管政策64-Year-Old Makes 9100% Gain, ...64-Year-Old Makes 9100% Gain, Pons Sparks Robinhood Launchpad WarmarsbitPublished on 2026-09-10Last updated on 2026-09-10AbstractA 64-year-old trader known as Bonk Guy, reportedly achieved near 9100% returns on a roughly $67,000 investment in PONS, the native token of the launchpad Pons on Robinhood Chain. His success highlights a fierce competition among launchpads on the emerging blockchain.

Pons, the current leader, operates a model where a portion of fees from newly created and traded tokens is used to buy back and burn PONS, directly linking platform activity to the token's value. It has captured a dominant share of new token launches and volume.

Meanwhile, competitors like LONG focus on pairing leveraged stock tokens with meme coins, creating hybrid speculative assets. Uniswap Labs entered the fray with its own low-fee platform, Pools, challenging Pons' model. Intriguingly, Uniswap Labs later became an investor in PONS, a move seen as hedging its bets on Robinhood Chain's growth.

The battle is fundamentally a fight for user traffic, which is currently heavily driven by meme coin speculation. A key uncertainty is whether this activity will sustain after Robinhood's initial gas fee subsidies end in late September.
